timeline.summary: Vinay Lohariwala, Promoter of Innova Captab Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter/PAC shares for FY2026 under SEBI Regulation 31(4) on 2026-04-03.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹447.8 Cr (+42.3% YoY), net profit ₹40.35 Cr (+36.5% YoY).

Innova Captab Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings call on 08-May-2026 at 11:00 AM (IST) for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via **www.innovacaptab.com/Audio Recording**, signed by **Neeharika Shukla**.
Innova Captab hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call reporting ₹1,630 Cr full-year revenue and guiding for 20%+ growth in FY27.
